create_config_context: create a temporary sklearn config context that sets assume_finite to True and restores it on exit
test_config_context: test the sklearn config_context manager preserves and restores config values across nested contexts
test_config_context_exception: test that sklearn config_context restores config values even when an exception is raised inside the context
test_set_config: test the sklearn set_config function globally updates assume_finite and rejects unknown arguments
test_config_threadsafe_joblib: test that sklearn config values remain thread-safe across joblib backends loky, multiprocessing, and threading
